ops.title: PRE-A6B BLOCKER: durable proposal-process registry + startup orphan scan (harness-kill accounting gap)

ops.text: A registry entry (name, pid, unit, start ts) is written durably at proposal spawn and removed on clean accounting; a startup scan treats an entry with no corresponding accounting record as latch-equivalent (refuse + reconcile; kill the orphan if alive)
A harness-level kill test (simulated SIGKILL/bootout: spawn, kill the harness process, restart) shows the orphaned proposal's existence is detected and the run refuses to start until reconciled
A6b's campaign runner is wired to this scan before its first unattended launchd deployment
